Shade areas, a brief notice late today
We write to travelers

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers with companion animals should review their check-in papers and follow the desk instructions before departure. Careful preparation helps the ground team move carriers safely and keeps each journey calm for pets and people alike.

If a crate is reported lost, travelers should bring forward the required claim details without delay. <<FACT F118>> For missed connections, the desk will review the case with care and explain the usual payment process. <<FACT F110>> These steps are meant to support fair handling and steady service.

Aurelia Skyways remains committed to dependable companion travel, and our staff will guide you through any needed document checks, carrier notes, or arrival updates. Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for direct support and further assistance.
